1.Name: Lesser Essence
1.Description: Using the power of your vivid imagination you are capable of creating projectiles made of pure essence! This essence is made up of the same things that make up your being.

2.Name: Power Essence
2.Description: Shoot Essence made of Powerfulness. Does big damage.

4.Name: Light Essence
4.Description: Does low damage, but is easy and quick to think of!

5.Name: Piercing Essence
5.Description: You've thought of something that is pointy enough to pierce through multiple enemies at once!

6.Name: Condensed Essence
6.Description: Strong and Short lived. You condensed powerful thoughts into this essential shot!

7.Name: Poison Essence
7.Description: Poisonous thoughts put together into this weapon let it do damage over time. It's stackable too!

8.Name: Multi Essence
8.Description: Allows you to dish out three times as many shots at once for three times as much damage!

9.Name: Splitting Essence
9.Description: Upon impact with foes, will split into 4 smaller projectiles that can damage other enemies!

10.Name: Charged Essence
10.Description: Flexible attack thought, can be rapidly shot, or held down for a stronger attack!

11.Name: Tomatoes
11.Description: Bring enemies down a peg, causing them to take more damage from all sources!

12.Name: Laser Essence
12.Description: A ray of laser-ey essence capable of damaging everything in a line.

13.Name: Hyper Essence
13.Description: Unleash a barrage of super hyper essence capable of doing big damage!

14.Name: Essence Beam
14.Description: A Solid Beam of pure essence, capable of dealing massive damage in a short period of time!

15.Name: Rainmaker
15.Description: Sad Cloud Weapondry shoots tears of sadness in all directions.

16.Name: Rising Spikes
16.Description: Send up spikes from below to instantly damage bosses in a line. Feels pointy.

51.Name: Soul Punches
51.Description: Get up close and beat up your imaginary foes.

52.Name: Power Whip
52.Description: A Strong Whip made out of pure power!

53.Name: Dreamer's Blade
53.Description: Blade made of dreams that does heavy damage to your enemies.

54.Name: Soul Strike
54.Description: Unleash a powerful strike that will heavily damage your strongest enemies!

101.Name: Rock Toss
101.Description: Just a rock, depending on the angle you throw it there might be sharp parts.

102.Name: Bag of Marbles
102.Description: A bag full of colorful marbles. Some are red, some are blue.

103.Name: Flying Disk
103.Description: A flying disk, capable of damaging multiple foes and sending fear into their hearts. Its also fun to play with.

104.Name: Shuriken
104.Description: Shurikens that had hateful thoughts infused into them, allowing them to seek out targets to damage.

105.Name: Spike Ball
105.Description: A really big pointy ball, rolls into your enemies and pushes them around!

106.Name: Boomerang Blade
106.Description: Like most boomerangs, this blade will turn around mid flight to deal damage again!

107.Name: Spinning Top
107.Description: These spin in place and do extra damage to enemies, neat to look at as well!

108.Name: Sharpshooter
108.Description: Weapon that shoots sharp objects really really fast.

109.Name: Throwing Knives
109.Description: Sharp and strong knives that will make your enemies bleed!

110.Name: Bow
110.Description: Powerful Bow and Arrow that can be drawn for extra critical hit chance.

111.Name: Crossbow
111.Description: Powerful Crossbow that can be quickly drawn for extra critical hit chance.

112.Name: Pins
112.Description: Throw a volley of pins at bosses that have a chance to make them bleed. Pins can also pin down incoming bullets.

113.Name: Marble Minigun
113.Description: Marble Minigun shoots marbles at an incredible speed!

114.Name: Saw Blade Launcher
114.Description: Shoots razor sharp rotating saw blades.

115.Name: Paper Airplane
115.Description: Homing paper airplane that shoots additional shots all across the battle field.

116.Name: Blow Dart
116.Description: Shoots powerful blow darts that inflict damage over time.

151.Name: Warrior's Blade
151.Description: Powerful Warrior's Blade that can destroy any bullets that it slashes!

152.Name: Safety Scissors
152.Description: Sharp Scissors that allow the soul to cut and inflict bleed to nearby enemies.

153.Name: Dream Striker
153.Description: Strike your enemies, rebound any incoming bullets back at the enemy!

201.Name: Arm Cannon
201.Description: Shoot bombs out of this cannon, which is planted on your non-existent arm.

202.Name: Snap Pops
202.Description: Snap your fingers to shoot pure explosiveness!

203.Name: Missile Launcher
203.Description: Fast heat seeking missiles, pretty powerful!

204.Name: Big Bomb Cannon
204.Description: Big Bombs that have big knockback and also shake up the enemy.

205.Name: Bombarder
205.Description: Bombard an area of your choosing with these air strike bombs.

206.Name: Boss Munchers
206.Description: These suckers will go after any nearby bosses and eat them up!

207.Name: Splodey Seeds
207.Description: Shoot multiple seeds that will sprout into explosions.

208.Name: Whoopie Cushion
208.Description: Unleashes a barrage of micro explosives!

209.Name: Firecrackers
209.Description: Firecracker explodes into fire which does additional damage.

210.Name: Pop Gun
210.Description: Pop Gun shoots rounds that explode into popcorn which can block incoming bullets.

212.Name: Grenade
212.Description: Extremely powerful explosive device, flies much further the longer you charge it.

213.Name: Explosion Machine
213.Description: Shoots massive balls of explosiveness that can pierce through foes and hit them several times.

301.Name: Magic Bolt Staff
301.Description: Shoots basic magic at your enemies.

302.Name: Charged Bolt Staff
302.Description: Charged magic is stronger than regular magic because it seeks to hit more.

303.Name: Fire Balls
303.Description: Does magic damage and then sets those enemies on fire.

304.Name: Frost Magic
304.Description: Frost magic explodes into frost Shards which do big damage, and can slow bosses down!

305.Name: Lightning Staff
305.Description: Strike your foes with magical lightning!

306.Name: Twister Staff
306.Description: Does continous twisting damage, also has big knockback power!

307.Name: Magic Bubbles
307.Description: Magic Bubbles have defensive and offensive capabilites!

308.Name: Earth Rune
308.Description: Earth Rune is surrounded by an aura which does big damage and can pierce through multiple enemies.

309.Name: Washing Tides
309.Description: Shoot waves that deal strong magic damage, and can destroy boss armour.

310.Name: Phase Magic
310.Description: High Level Magic that can loop through the sides of the dreamscape to do more damage.

311.Name: Magic Shields
311.Extra_Stats: x4 Orbital Shot +Bullet Blocking +No Damage Potential
311.Description: Magic Shields orbit the soul, protecting it from damage sources.

312.Name: Adept Staff
312.Description: One of the most adept forms of magic can be generated using this staff! Charge up to deal massive damage to any foe.

313.Name: Boss Maw
313.Description: Takes a chunk out of bosses and restores your health proportional to the damage dealt.

314.Name: Blade Staff
314.Description: Summons twin blades infused with magic from the ground.

402.Name: Connective Sparks
402.Description: Sparks that can bounce from foe to foe.

403.Name: Laser Barrage
403.Description: Shoots a barrage of lasers, fairly accurate and powerful!

404.Name: Plasma Visor
404.Description: Plasma does big damage and can be thought of pretty fast, however very draining to think of.

405.Name: Power Gun
405.Description: Powerful Weapon capable of charging a large amount of power.

406.Name: Bouncer Gun
406.Description: Shoot fast waves that can bounce off walls.

407.Name: Tesla Coil
407.Description: Shoots Static electricity that homes in on any nearby foes.

408.Name: Shocking Gun
408.Description: Shoots shocking projectiles which split in the air into damaging energy.

409.Name: Charge Rod
409.Description: Creates charges that orbit the soul and then get released all at once!

410.Name: Energy Crystal
410.Description: Powerful energy crystal, capable of shooting lasers at high speeds.

411.Name: Forcefield Charger
411.Description: This weapon can charge up a powerful forcefield that blocks bullets and can severely damage bosses.

412.Name: Energy Bomb Cannon
412.Description: Shoots a massive ball of energy that does massive damage to the screen.

413.Name: Idea Cannon
413.Description: Shoots a massive projectile, that stays mostly stationary and relentlessly shoots extra projectiles at nearby enemies.

414.Name: Dream Cell
414.Description: High voltage battery capable of doing consecutive energy damage in a short range. Also shoots electrial bursts in 4 directions.

501.Name: Fleeting Soul Staff
501.Description: Summon Fleeting Souls to assist you in battle!

502.Name: Manifesting Rod
502.Description: Summon Manifestations to assist you in battle!

503.Name: Battle Flag
503.Description: Summon Soul Knights that have powerful blades!

504.Name: Anvil Rod
504.Description: Summon Large and sturdy figments that ram into bosses and can take large amounts of damage.

505.Name: Drone Remote
505.Description: Summon drone souls that aggressively follow bosses and shoot at them.

601.Name: Healing Essence
601.Description: Quickly Heals the soul, more potent with a higher vitality stat.

602.Name: Healing Barrier
602.Description: Heals you and ally figments within the barrier, and also blocks bullets for a short time.

603.Name: Brainstorm Umbrella
603.Description: Blocks bullet rain patterns, redirects bullets back to the direction of your astral cursor.

604.Name: Bounce Forcefield
604.Description: Protects the soul, and redirects all incoming bullets backwards.

605.Name: Heart Pick
605.Description: Activates Current Heart Effect, also does +10 damage to everything on screen.
